<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Twice in two days a verdict seat sat for about two hours on a harness question dialog while pij reported it working, and every PR waiting on it stalled. This plan has the daemon detect that state cheaply and say so. One coder after plan 218.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- The daemon notices a working seat that has been silent 20+ minutes, reads its pane through the existing control client, matches the harness's own modal-UI markers, and tells its parent and PA once, with the key that clears it.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Pressing keys or choosing options for a seat.
- Detecting stalls by reading the content of the seat's work.
- Any new tmux process or timer.

| ac-0001 | Spot a stalled working seat. Inside an existing daemon round (the PA watchdog's 60 s round), a live seat whose state is working, with a pane, on a harness with known dialog markers (Copilot and Claude; OMP and Pi have none captured yet), and which has had no OWN event (activity post, report, inbox ack; deliveries to it don't count) for 20 minutes is a candidate. Only candidates' panes are read. A healthy working seat on such a harness costs one spine read per round (one snapshot of four indexed per-kind SELECTs) and no pane read; other seats cost nothing. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0001](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0002 | Read the pane without a launch, and match the harness's own modal markers. For a candidate, read the visible pane once through the daemon's persistent tmux control client (crates/tmux/src/control.rs, capture-pane is already an allowed read), never a new tmux process. Match only per-harness modal-UI markers kept in a table beside the harness adapters: for Copilot the selection footer (e.g. 'select · enter accept · ctrl+d decline · esc cancel') and 'Copilot needs information', for Claude its permission and question prompts, for OMP and Pi theirs. Markers must sit in the harness's chrome region (the last lines, after the input box), not in model output, so a seat whose work is ABOUT dialogs (quoting the marker in code or chat) does not trip it. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0002](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0003 | Tell, once per stretch. On a match the daemon sends one FYI-free normal message to the seat's parent and to the PA of its fleet (or the prime when there's no PA): seat, harness, how long it has been stalled, the dialog's first line, and the key that clears it (Copilot: ctrl+d declines, enter accepts the highlighted option; never choose an option for the seat). Once per stretch: the claim is stored before sending (as plan 217's presence claims are) and re-arms only after the seat records a new event. It never presses keys itself. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0003](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

One modal_stalls read per round only when a seat is a candidate; a write only to claim, record a recipient, or open or close a row. Measure before and after: ping spawns flat (no tmux.capture-pane or tmux.control-client from this path); control-client read count per round with one fixture-stalled seat. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0005](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

F47 (06 Nov, pm-001): a modal question in a pij seat stalls it silently while pij list shows working. pij-wary-lynx sat on one 13:30-15:16 on 06 Nov; pij-bumpy-herring sat on Copilot's 'Choose an optional follow-up' dialog (Fix highest severity issues / Fix all issues / Commit a summary of findings / Other; footer '↑/↓ select · enter accept · ctrl+d decline · esc cancel') from 21:01 to 22:55 on 07 Nov after publishing a verdict, while pij-rs state showed working with 'last call 1h53m ago'. Each cleared with ctrl+d. Both stalls delayed every PR waiting on that seat. The daemon already keeps a persistent tmux control client for reads (plan 180 cost rule; crates/tmux/src/control.rs allows capture-pane). Interim: the PA checks panes of seats silent over 30 min. Spec from the prime, 2026-11-07 22:56.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
